From: Maya Patel <maya@finly.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot runway extension — integration blocker

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from the eng side — our backend team hit an unexpected blocker with Finly's SAML adapter (third-party library incompatibility). The connector is failing when trying to exchange the initial tokens; we've attached a short error dump for context.

This has pushed our integration timeline by ~7 business days and would put our demo window outside the trial sandbox we've been using. Given the timing, can Redwood extend the pilot credits and sandbox window by two weeks so we can finish the adapter fix and validate the end-to-end flows?

We appreciate the flexibility — we're excited about the integration and want to avoid a rushed demo that misrepresents the platform.

Best,
Maya Patel
Director of Engineering, Finly Inc.
